bio_en: Feixi was a Tang monk associated with Dasheng Qianfu Monastery. He participated in Amoghavajra's translation activities and studied both esoteric practice and Pure Land devotion. His Treatise on the Jewel-King Samadhi of Buddha Recollection discusses the doctrinal basis and practice of recollecting the Buddha.
bio_summary: 飛錫居大聖千福寺，參不空譯場，兼研密教與淨業。著《念佛三昧寶王論》，明念佛三昧之義。
name: 飛錫
